Apple rolled out the iPadOS 27 public beta 3, as well as new betas for tvOS 27, HomePod 27, and more.

Apple releases iPadOS 27 public beta 3 and more

It's been a few weeks since the last round of public betas, but the wait is finally over today.

iPadOS 27 public beta 3 is rolling out now, alongside new betas for tvOS 27, HomePod 27, and more.

We still have around a month to go until these major new versions of the software are publicly released, and public beta 3 brings another round of updates that's more stable and smoother.

What's new in iPadOS 27 public beta 3:

  • Redesigned icons for apps like Siri, Safari, Preview, etc.
  • More options for customizing the Siri voice
  • New search option in Settings
  • New AI usage limits details for iCloud+
  • and more

Apple's public beta 3 update is the same version as "beta 5," which was released to developers yesterday.

After a day of testing, these updates seem to be considerably more stable overall than previous betas.

You'll still run into the occasional bug here and there, but Apple has made significant progress over the last few weeks as it prepares for next month's official launch.

Are you finding any new features in the latest betas? Let us know in the comments.
